test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) is/are correct?

1. A new Centrally Sponsored Scheme, namely, National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) was launched by the Government of India in 2021.

2. It aims to promote oil palm cultivation for making the country Aatma Nirbhar in edible oils with special focus on North-Eastern States and A&N Islands.

3. The Mission aims to bring additional area of 6.5 lakh ha under Oil Palm plantation in the next 5 years, from 2025-26 to 2030-31.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched in 2021** by the Government of India.
 
• The mission aims to reduce India's dependency on imported edible oils by **promoting domestic oil palm cultivation**.
 
• The focus areas of the scheme include the **North-Eastern States and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands**, which have favorable conditions for oil palm farming.
 
• The scheme includes financial assistance to farmers for planting material, maintenance, and intercropping, as well as subsidies for processing units.
 
• The statement regarding bringing an additional area of 6.5 lakh hectares under oil palm plantation from 2025-26 to 2030-31 is **incorrect**; the scheme aims to achieve this target by 2025-26.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Edible Oil Import Dependency**

 
 
• India is one of the largest importers of edible oils, importing nearly 60% of its consumption annually.
 
• Oil palm has the highest oil yield per hectare compared to other oilseed crops, making it a crucial crop for reducing import dependency.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Sustainability**
 
 
• The NMEO-OP emphasizes environmentally sustainable practices for oil palm cultivation to ensure long-term benefits for farmers and ecosystems.
 
• It includes measures to avoid deforestation and protect biodiversity in cultivation areas.
 
 
 
• **Government Support under NMEO-OP**
 
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance for planting material, maintenance of plantations, and setting up oil palm processing units.
 
• Price Assurance Mechanism ensures minimum support prices for farmers, reducing their financial risks.
 
 
 
• **Global Context**
 
 
• Countries like Indonesia and Malaysia dominate global palm oil production, contributing over 80% of the world's supply.
 
• India's NMEO-OP is aimed at enhancing domestic production to compete with these global players.
